public_roi_comparison.reference_target: Publisher named L1-L4 vendor bone-area ROIs, not complete vertebral-body contours
limitations: Only ten annotated case folders; identities across folders not independently verified.
Publisher pretrained-model training overlap not independently ruled out.
Center distances use DICOM calibration or reader fallback, recorded per case.
No Th12, iliac crest or disc-boundary reference.
Ordered predicted labels do not establish numbering accuracy on organizer images.
Publisher ROIs differ from projected full anatomical bodies; Dice is an overlap comparison of different targets.
Ten external annotated folders do not establish generalization to all scanners; pretraining overlap not independently audited.
Default physical scale for external images is uncertain; distances are not established millimeter accuracy.
No iliac-crest, hip-trochanter or source-ROI acceptance established.
